name: Subclavian vein
notes: Drains into the brachiocephalic vein; continuation of the axillary vein.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Axillary vein
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Cephalic vein
notes: Superficial vein, ascends the lateral arm/forearm, drains into the axillary v. via the deltopectoral groove/clavipectoral fascia (piercing point).
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Basilic vein
notes: Superficial vein, ascends the medial forearm/arm, pierces deep fascia at the mid-arm to join the brachial veins forming the axillary v.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Median cubital vein
notes: Connects cephalic and basilic veins across the cubital fossa; classic venipuncture site.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Brachial veins (venae comitantes)
notes: Paired deep veins accompanying the brachial artery.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Radial veins (venae comitantes)
supplies_or_drains: deep lateral forearm, accompanying radial artery territory
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Ulnar veins (venae comitantes)
supplies_or_drains: deep medial forearm, accompanying ulnar artery territory
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

name: Dorsal venous network of the hand
notes: Superficial plexus draining the hand; origin of the cephalic (radial side) and basilic (ulnar side) veins.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) ch.7; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
